error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE: "[UE 0] CB-RA: Contention resolution timer has expired, RA procedure has failed..."  
Context: This error occurs repeatedly after the RA-Msg3 transmission in the MAC layer, indicating that the contention-based random access procedure fails due to the contention resolution timer expiring. This failure prevents successful random access and thus blocks the UE from establishing RRC connection, critically impacting system operation.
